trials.claim: Future Solo and Team plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Solo (Tier 1), Team (Tiers 2, 3) plan updates
trials.reasoning: E7 only shows the app was updated once after purchase, which does not prove that all future Solo and Team plan updates are contractually included.

exhibits.quote: since I bought I noted that the app has been updated and it make me happy also because it has everything that I need to my campaigns
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms receiving app updates after purchase on Tier 2, supporting that plan updates are included.

trials.claim: Centralized platform for leads, outreach, replies
trials.claimQuote: Find qualified leads, run automated LinkedIn outreach, and centralize replies in one platform
trials.reasoning: E8 states lead finding, outreach, and inbox are combined in one platform, and E9 confirms prospect discovery, list management, and LinkedIn outreach are in the same application; the prosecution exhibits do not materially undercut centralization.

exhibits.quote: it looked like it would do full campaigns for me, but it seems more like an
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the product functions as manual connection sending rather than a centralized automated campaign platform.

exhibits.quote: Your LinkedIn session has expired. All LinkedIn activity is paused until you reconnect.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows outreach and centralization stops when LinkedIn disconnects, undermining always-on platform claim.

exhibits.quote: Flow AI combines lead finding, outreach, and inbox in one platform—so you don’t need separate tools or multiple licences.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states lead finding, outreach and inbox are combined in one platform.

exhibits.quote: I like that Flow brings prospect discovery, list management and LinkedIn outreach into the same application.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms discovery, list management and outreach are together in the same application.

trials.claim: Search 300M+ LinkedIn profiles and run automated outreach sequences
trials.claimQuote: Flow AI lets you search 300M+ LinkedIn profiles, run outreach sequences automatically, and collect all your replies in one shared inbox.
trials.reasoning: E3 reports major limitations on search due to LinkedIn blocks and E4 reports unrelated profiles for an easily searchable company, materially limiting the claimed 300M+ search and outreach capability.

exhibits.quote: the biggest shortcomings are the limitations on search. It's not their fault, it's LinkedIn that has put up blocks
exhibits.argument: Quote admits search is limited by LinkedIn blocks, undermining 300M+ search claim.

exhibits.quote: The results included unrelated profiles. This wasn’t an obscure startup. It was a well-known company whose employees I can find through a basic LinkedIn search.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the 300M+ search returned unrelated results even for a well-known company.

exhibits.quote: Search over 300M+ leads, scale multi-sender outreach, and book more meetings on LinkedIn—all in one platform.
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises searching 300M+ leads and scaling outreach in one platform.

exhibits.quote: Let Flow AI warm prospects up for you on auto-pilot using a proven campaign that grows your LinkedIn network while you sleep.
exhibits.argument: Vendor describes automated auto-pilot campaigns that warm prospects without manual work.

trials.claim: Database of 300M+ verified profiles searchable by role, industry, size, location
trials.claimQuote: Search a database of 300M+ verified profiles by role, industry, company size, and location
trials.reasoning: E5 shows search returned unrelated profiles for a well-known company and E6 shows AI search failed to correctly extract narrow industry targeting, contradicting reliable filtering by the claimed criteria.

exhibits.quote: The results included unrelated profiles. This wasn’t an obscure startup. It was a well-known company whose employees I can find through a basic LinkedIn search.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows the verified database search failed filtering by current company for a well-known firm.

exhibits.quote: The biggest issue I've had is getting the AI search to correctly extract info from my admittedly narrow target band on an industry.
exhibits.argument: Quote shows search cannot reliably filter by industry targeting criteria.

exhibits.quote: Search a 300M+ database to build targeted, enriched lead lists—without relying on expensive 3rd-party tools.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states users can search a 300M+ database to build targeted lead lists.

exhibits.quote: I also appreciate the built-in lead database, the ability to target prospects based on specific criteria, and the flexibility to manage multiple accounts and campaigns.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the built-in lead database allows targeting prospects by specific criteria.
